newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli FM warns against international pressure.
newsitem.headline: Israeli FM warns against international pressure.

text.p: Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy warned on Tuesday that PLO efforts to bring international pressure on Israel could freeze peace moves.

"Any appeal which could bring about international involvement could -- and I am warning that such a danger exists even if Israel does not want it to come about -- bring about a freeze in the political process," Levy told reporters on Tuesday.

His remarks followed Palestinian President Yasser Arafat's decision to convene a meeting on Saturday with U.S., European and Arab envoys to discuss the crisis brewing since Israel approved plans to build a Jewish settlement between Arab East Jerusalem and Bethlehem.
The crisis deepened last Friday when Israel disclosed the depth of the first of three West Bank pullbacks. It offered Palestinians about a third of what they wanted.
"Israel will not surrender to pressure," Levy said.
He said Arafat's moves were an attempt to pressure Israel into more territorial concessions and constituted a violation of Israel-PLO accords.
